title: Orphera DNS config
description: The parameters of manifests/gen_set_dns.scala (config/dns.yaml): the same top-level `params:` as a per-VM config, but a different set of keys. gen_set_dns can also be pointed at a per-VM config (see vm-config.schema.json), and then takes its one node from hostname and its resolvers from dns1, dns2 and domainname.

nodes.description: The nodes to configure, by inventory name. If omitted, a per-VM file's hostname is used.

dns_servers.description: Resolvers in order of preference: IPv4 or IPv6 literals.

round_robin.description: true: spread queries across the servers (glibc `options rotate` in a static /etc/resolv.conf) instead of the systemd-resolved drop-in, which only fails over. Needs 2 or 3 servers.
